title: Corpse Collector
description: A poor and handsome Bulgarian falls for women who only exploit him. Itso, about 35, drives a special ambulance called a 'corpse-van'. His job is to pick up the bodies of the recently deceased and transport them to the morgue. Itso's assistant is a Gypsy with the nickname 'Buddy'. Mimi, a nice and lovable ward-maid from the morgue likes Itso, but he doesn't really pay much attention to her, because he is in love with Katya, an attractive 40 years old woman. Katya humiliates Itso and uses him, but it doesn't change his feelings for her. His attitude can only be explained by the way his mother used to treat him - with care but also with sadism at times. Katya turns out to be a mistress of the mafia boss Rocco, who beats her and one of the days - brutally rapes her, which is seen by Itso. Buddy convinces Itso that real men deal with life problems by administering justice themselves. Itso decides to rescue Katya and her 14-year old son Mario from Rocco, and free the world from a villain... This complex story, referring to subconscious, psychology and symbolism, is not only about freeing the world from outside evil, but also freeing a man from inside demons...
description_pl: Itso jeździ karawanem. Jego praca polega na przewożeniu zwłok z sofijskich ulic i domów do kostnicy. Jeździ z asystentem Cyganem Buddym. W kostnicy pracuje Mimi, która bardzo lubi Itso, ale on nie zwraca na nią uwagi, bo jest zakochany w Katii, atrakcyjnej 40-latce. Kobieta go poniża i wykorzystuje, ale to nie zmienia jego uczuć do niej. Katia jest kochanką mafijnego bossa, który jest wobec niej bardzo brutalny. Buddy przekonuje Itso, że prawdziwy mężczyzna radzi sobie z problemami wymierzając sprawiedliwość samodzielnie. Itso decyduje się uratować Katię i jej 14-letniego syna, a świat uwolnić od łotra.
